name: voicelab
description: VoiceLab is an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, meeting notetaking, and voice agents. Turn text into natural speech, transcribe audio files, upload meeting recordings for transcripts and AI notes, remove background noise, and connect voice tools to agents via MCP. Audio can be provided as a file attached in ChatGPT, a public HTTPS link, or a small base64 payload.

interface.longDescription: VoiceLab is an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, meeting notetaking, and voice agents. Turn text into natural speech, transcribe audio files, upload meeting recordings for transcripts and AI notes, remove background noise, and connect voice tools to agents via MCP. Audio can be provided as a file attached in ChatGPT, a public HTTPS link, or a small base64 payload.
capabilities: Meeting AI: upload recordings, get transcripts and notes
Upload audio files from ChatGPT or by link
defaultPrompt: Summarize this meeting recording with notes
Generate speech for: Hello, welcome to VoiceLab

positive.prompt: Use VoiceLab to generate English speech for: Hello, welcome to our product demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns base64-encoded audio with natural speech

positive.prompt: Transcribe this audio file with speaker labels using VoiceLab
positive.expected_behavior: Returns transcription with word timing and speaker labels

positive.prompt: Show me available English voices in VoiceLab
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of voices with metadata

positive.prompt: Remove background noise from this audio using VoiceLab
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a job id, then isolated audio when complete

positive.prompt: Create a VoiceLab realtime WebSocket ticket for streaming TTS
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ticket usable for realtime streaming

positive.prompt: Use VoiceLab to transcribe this attached meeting recording and give me the notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a meeting from the ChatGPT file, then returns transcript and AI notes once status is ready

positive.prompt: Create a VoiceLab meeting from https://example.com/standup.mp3 and summarize it when ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a queued meeting id, then transcript and notes after polling

positive.prompt: Transcribe this attached audio file with VoiceLab, with speaker labels.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a transcription job, then text with timing and speaker labels

positive.prompt: Transcribe https://example.com/interview.wav in English with VoiceLab.
positive.expected_behavior: Accepts audio_url and returns the transcription when complete

positive.prompt: List my recent VoiceLab meetings and rename the latest one to Weekly sync.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns meeting history and confirms the new title

positive.prompt: Which languages does VoiceLab Meeting AI support?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns supported meeting languages and feature flags

negative.prompt: Generate speech with voice ID nonexistent_voice_123
negative.expected_behavior: Returns a validation error for invalid voice_id

negative.prompt: Generate speech in Klingon using VoiceLab
negative.expected_behavior: Shows only supported languages or returns an error

negative.prompt: Transcribe audio without providing any audio file
negative.expected_behavior: Returns an error that audio input is required

negative.prompt: Create a VoiceLab meeting using both https://example.com/a.mp3 and this attached file.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns a validation error: provide exactly one audio source
Returns a validation error: audio_url must be HTTPS

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
